Team —

- Confirm flights & arrival ETA for Marco and Elena (we expect arrivals 9/21 late afternoon).
- EA escort for arrival through to the workshop (on-site Redwood EA to meet at SFO arrivals).
- Hotel: corporate rate at The Meridian — need check-in name & confirmation.
- Secure meeting room with closed-network laptop + guest VLAN + video-sanitized connection.
- AV + mic check scheduled 9/22 07:30am.
- Dietary and ground transport (car with secure partition).
- NDA / discussion items: procurement will hand docs at the start; have printed copies.

I attached a rough itinerary template for capture. Please reply with ownership for: airport pickup, EA escort, AV lead, and final run-of-show owner by EOD 9/8.

Thanks — Camila
